as_told.title: Contractor sees craft hovering in Dugway building

plain: A contractor known only as MS is said to have walked into a remote building in the Avery section of Dugway Proving Ground, a military test range in Utah, while reading electric meters, and found a craft there. An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb tells this in two episodes, passing on what he was told. The two tellings differ: in one the craft seemed to be in the middle of being taken apart, in the other the unnamed worker, a contractor for a Martin company at the West Desert Test Wing, saw it "hovering in the air being tested on." If true, the military would be studying an unknown craft in the Utah desert.
